From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: SCIM delta + SSO assertion samples for SOC 2 audit (request)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for taking this on. Our SOC 2 auditor asked for a compact artefact set to validate access-control and provisioning controls for the period Oct–Nov 2026. Specifically we need: 

- SCIM delta export (user create/update/deactivate) covering a 2‑week high-change window.
- Representative SAML assertion samples for login and JIT admin elevation.
- An access ownership matrix mapping role names to owner email and source-of-truth (SCIM attribute) for service accounts and admin roles.

Two constraints from the audit team: any PII in assertion samples should be redacted, and file names should include a short manifest with timestamped entries. If you can provide a short workback plan + ETA (including redaction approach), that would be great.

Target delivery for initial samples is EOD 30 Dec if feasible — the auditor wants to ingest into their toolchain early next week.

Appreciate it,
Elena Ruiz
Head of InfoSec Programs
NovaMed

[This message was sent from security@novamed.com on behalf of elena@novamed.com]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + SSO assertion samples for SOC 2 audit (request)

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can put together a compact evidence bundle that meets the auditor constraints. High-level plan below: 

1) Scope selection (today): we will extract a 14‑day SCIM delta window centered on Nov 10–23, 2026 (high-change window identified by our provisioning telemetry). We will filter to tenant namespace "novamed-prod" and include attributes: userName, id, active, roles, manager, created, lastModified.

2) SAML assertion samples (tomorrow): provide 6 samples — 3 interactive logins and 3 elevated-session assertions (JIT admin). We will proactively redact email aliases and include assertion metadata (Issuer, Audience, AuthnInstant). Samples will include clear redaction markers (e.g., [REDACTED_EMAIL]).

3) Access ownership matrix (tomorrow afternoon): CSV/XLSX mapping role -> owner -> source attribute (e.g., scim:groups or internal role mapping), plus responsibility notes for service accounts.

4) Delivery (30 Dec): bundle with a short manifest.txt + integrity SHA256s.

Attachments I will drop in this thread: scim-delta-sample.csv (anonymized, 120KB), sso-assertion-sample.txt (redacted), access-ownership-matrix.xlsx (summary sheet). If the auditor needs raw logs beyond the samples (e.g., full SAML logs or SCIM event stream), we'll coordinate via secure share and a short data-processing agreement.

ETA: Initial bundle to you by 2026-12-30 15:00 PST. If you need earlier, let me know and I'll prioritize.

Irene — can you prepare the SCIM extractor and include the SCIM change type column? Markus — please confirm redaction approach for assertion samples (we'll follow our standard redaction script but wanted a quick sign-off).

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Manager, Compliance & Security Solutions
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: sso-assertion-sample.txt (TXT, 4KB)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai

Elena / Team —

We delivered the sample bundle to the secure Drive link and included a manifest with SHA256 checksums. Notes on redaction and fidelity:

- SCIM delta: we replaced identifiable email localparts with deterministic tokens (user_####) so the auditor can still validate the delta patterns without PII. ChangeType column includes CREATE/UPDATE/DEACTIVATE.

- SAML assertions: redacted subject/email values but preserved attributes required for mapping (NameID format, eduPersonAffiliation, role claims). AuthnInstant and Audience fields are intact.

- Ownership matrix: includes owner email (redacted) and the authoritative source column (SCIM group vs internal role-mapping table). We flagged five service accounts with ambiguous ownership — see the "issues" tab for recommended owners and suggested remediation (role pruning or owner assignment).

Links and artifacts: 
- Drive: https://drive.reddemo.com/novamed/SCIM-delta-samples (folder, read-only link)
- JIRA ticket for follow-up (if auditor requests raw logs): JIRA-REQ-4321

If the auditor wants raw SAML logs (full headers) we will provide them under an NDA addendum and a short workback to remove session tokens. For now, the redacted samples plus ownership matrix should satisfy the SOC 2 control test steps around provisioning and least privilege review.

Elena — confirming this meets your ask; if so, we'll mark the ticket complete and archive the raw extraction.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
